result.title: Editing Faster in Adobe Premiere with NVIDIA RTX Spark
result.description:

result.title: Building Europe's AI Stack — Inside the Barcelona Supercomputing Center
result.description:
We sat down with the Barcelona Supercomputing Center to talk about what it really takes to turn a continent's scientific ambition into an AI powerhouse.

BSC hosts MareNostrum 5 — one of the largest supercomputers in Europe. But raw compute is just the start. The BSC AI Factory, backed by the European Commission, is doing something harder: compressing the journey from idea to deployable AI product for the startups and SMEs who can't afford to wait.

The model is simple in concept, hard to execute: energy → chips → infrastructure → models → applications. Five layers. One coherent stack.

result.title: The Industrialization of Intelligence
result.description:
Taiwan helped build the computing era. Now its semiconductor ecosystem is building the infrastructure, systems, and software that power the AI era.

This video celebrates Taiwan’s technology ecosystem and the engineers, researchers, manufacturers, developers, and partners turning breakthroughs in chip design, advanced manufacturing, accelerated computing, and AI into technology used around the world.

Created for SEMICON Taiwan 2026.

Presented with Chinese subtitles.

result.title: Tokenomics 101: What Are Tokens & Why They Matter | AI Factory Insider Ep. 4
result.description:
In Episode 4 of AI Factory Insider, host Kaushik Shirhatti (VP, AI Factory, NVIDIA) is joined by Shruti Koparkar (Sr. Manager, Product Marketing, NVIDIA) and Tue Tran (GTM Strategic Ops, NVIDIA) to discuss what a token actually is, why not all tokens are equal, and how to tie AI factory investment to real business ROI.

What we cover: 
0:00 — Introduction 
1:28 — Meet our guests: Shruti Koparkar & Tue Tran 
2:42 — What is a token? 
3:54 — What is "tokenomics," and why is it relevant now? 
4:58 — Not all tokens are equal: intelligence, context, and speed 
7:44 — Trading vs. research: matching tokens to the use case 
9:20 — Retail video: one-token answers vs. batch captioning 
10:40 — Sizing token demand: back-of-napkin math 
12:10 — The multipliers: reasoning, agentic loops, and cache hit rate 
13:54 — KV cache and prefix matching explained 
16:34 — Supply: the AI factory as a car engine 
17:29 — Dense models vs. mixture of experts 
20:19 — Right model for the right task: a telco example 
21:24 — Intelligent routing with NeMo Switchyard 
22:10 — Where are your tokens going? Observability with NeMo Relay 
22:38 — Matching infrastructure: NVL72, HGX, and RTX PRO Servers 
23:31 — Dynamo and extreme co-design 
24:25 — Monetization: four paths from tokens to ROI 
27:54 — Just get started, and make it a team effort 
29:18 — Guardrails for a token tsunami 
31:32 — Wrap-up
